name: singlet_neighbors_neighbor_count_selection
title: Choose neighbour count k by partition stability
description: Chooses the neighbour count k for a cell kNN graph from a candidate grid; k follows the Scanpy n_neighbors convention and counts the cell itself. By default (selection_rule partition_stability) it returns the smallest k whose Leiden partition, recomputed on random cell subsamples, reproduces the full-data partition; it needs only the embedding, and reference labels add ARI, NMI and graph-connectivity columns. It reads an obsm embedding from earlier steps (X_pca by default, first n_pcs columns) and writes a per-k table and a selection record under uns/<key>. Do not use it to build the final graph (run neighbors.approximate_knn_search with the chosen k), to choose the number of PCs or the clustering resolution, on raw counts, or to report a label-optimised k as validated.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

embedding.description: Embedding used for every neighbour search.

use_rep.description: Key of the obsm embedding (cells by dimensions); it must contain no missing values.

n_pcs.description: Number of leading embedding columns used. Use the value from dim-reduction.pc_number_selection when that step has run.

k_grid.description: Candidate neighbour counts, each at least 3, counting the cell itself. The largest is k_max; the subsample size must exceed k_max.

selection_rule.description: partition_stability: label-free, smallest k with stability at least min_stability. label_ari: benchmarking only, uses labels. coclustering_robustness: label-free, memory-heavy, highest median co-clustering silhouette.

graph.description: Graph construction from each k-prefix, and the fixed Leiden step applied at every k.

method.description: umap: fuzzy simplicial set with smooth-kNN calibration to log2 k. snn: shared-neighbour Jaccard weights, pruned at snn_prune.

snn_prune.description: Jaccard weights below this value are dropped (Seurat default 1/15). Used only by method snn.

search.description: exact: brute-force search. approximate: the engine of neighbors.approximate_knn_search; its recall is not measured here.

leiden_resolution.description: Fixed Leiden resolution used for every partition at every k.

leiden_seeds.description: Leiden seeds per k on the full data. Values above 1 give the seed spread of ARI, NMI and GC and the seed floor.

subsampling.description: Cell subsampling for partition stability, the label_ari stability guard and coclustering_robustness.

fraction.description: Fraction of cells drawn without replacement into each subsample.

min_stability.description: Threshold on mean partition ARI between subsample and full data. Uncalibrated. Ignored by coclustering_robustness.

labels.description: Optional reference labels. Required for label_ari; otherwise they add reporting columns only.

reference_label_key.description: obs column of reference labels used for ARI, NMI and graph connectivity.

score_mask_key.description: obs boolean column; only true cells are scored, for example to exclude doublets. Cells with a missing label are always excluded.

ari_tolerance.description: Tolerance below the best ARI among stable k. Used by label_ari only.

output.description: Names and extent of the written members.

key.description: Stem of the output members uns/<key>/table, uns/<key>/selection and obs/<key>_leiden_k<k>.

write_partitions.description: Write one full-data Leiden partition per k to obs/<key>_leiden_k<k>, from the first seed.

device.description: Execution device for the exact search; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available. Leiden runs on CPU.

seed.description: Seed for subsample draws, Leiden runs and approximate search. A fixed seed, search and device reproduce the output on the same hardware.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and the planned numbers of searches and Leiden runs without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members with the same key instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/neighbor_k_selection/table and uns/neighbor_k_selection/selection. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: selection_rule, chosen_k, fallback_used, stability_target_met, selection_uses_labels, per_k records (k, n_clusters, pstab, pstab_sd, seed_floor, ari_mean, ari_min, ari_max, nmi, gc, median_silhouette and interval bounds; null where not computed), search requested and resolved, device, n_cells, n_pcs, peak_memory_gb, seconds. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, resolved search, planned_searches (one full search plus n_subsamples subsample searches), planned_leiden_runs and, for coclustering_robustness, the frequency-matrix size.
